                    ### Question
                    Regarding the administration of drugs subcutaneously, which of the following statements is correct ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. The incorporation of vasoconstrictors, such as adrenaline, increases the speed of absorption.
opb. It is a parenteral route of difficult access.
opc. When drugs are administered in this way repeatedly, for example insulin in type I diabetics, it is recommended not to alternate the injection site to avoid the appearance of lipodystrophies.
opd. Solid forms of sustained release can be implanted to obtain extended periods of release of some drugs.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Subcutaneous drug administration is generally slower than intravenous route due to passing through skin and subcutaneous tissue. Vasoconstrictors like adrenaline can increase absorption speed by constricting blood vessels at the injection site. Repeated subcutaneous injections at the same site can lead to lipodystrophies, so alternating injection sites is recommended. Solid forms of sustained-release drugs can be implanted subcutaneously for extended release periods. The incorporation of vasoconstrictors like adrenaline can enhance absorption speed when added to subcutaneously administered drugs.
